info.description: Private bank API — syncs Fio Bank transaction data into Postgres, matches member payments to their bank transactions, and detects missed dues. Dev-only documentation (see config.EnableSwaggerDocs): every route below requires a Keycloak bearer token unless noted otherwise.
info.title: Bank System API

get.description: Requires the manage-bank-accounts role. Excludes the Fio token itself, only whether one is set. balance/balance_as_of are both null until the account's first successful sync. color is null unless set.

post.description: Requires the manage-bank-accounts role. fio_token is encrypted at rest and never echoed back. color is optional, must be a #RRGGBB hex code.

delete.description: Requires the manage-bank-accounts role. The row and its sync history are kept, just marked inactive.

patch.description: Requires the manage-bank-accounts role. fio_account_id/iban/currency are Fio-assigned and not editable here. color is optional (#RRGGBB), full overwrite — omit or send "" to clear.
patch.summary: Update a bank account's label and/or Fio token

post.description: Requires the manage-bank-accounts role. Pulls via Fio's /periods/ endpoint for a date range predating the account's cursor-based sync; ranges over 90 days old need SCA unlocked in Fio's own Internet Banking first. Runs transaction processing synchronously afterward.
post.summary: Backfill historical transactions for one account

409.description: debug mode, or account inactive/has no token

post.description: Requires the manage-bank-accounts role. Refuses (409) in debug mode (DEBUG=true). Runs transaction processing synchronously afterward.
post.summary: Trigger an immediate Fio sync for one account

409.description: debug mode, or account inactive/has no token

get.description: Requires the view-audit-logs role. One entry per authenticated POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE request (who, what, when), newest first. status_code is the response status — rejected attempts are included, filter to 2xx client-side for changes that took effect.

parameters.description: bank_account, processing, transaction, category, waiver or other
parameters.name: category

get.description: Requires the view-budget role. Newest year first.

post.description: Requires the manage-budget role. Creates an empty budget, or with copy_from_year a copy of that year's lines (budgeted amounts and category mappings included). 409 if the year already has one; 400 if copy_from_year has no budget.

409.description: budget for this year already exists

get.description: Requires the view-budget role. Lines in display order (sort_order, then id), each with its mapped category_ids, budgeted and actual (that year's CZK transactions in those categories; signed, a refund lowers it). unbudgeted: categories with transactions that year but no line (internal transfers excluded). other_currency_count: non-CZK transactions left out. Amounts are decimal strings, always CZK.
get.summary: Get one year's budget vs. actual

delete.description: Requires the manage-budget role. Deletes the budget and all its lines. Transactions are not affected.

patch.description: Requires the manage-budget role. Omit note or send "" to clear it.

post.description: Requires the manage-budget role. budgeted is a non-negative decimal string; kind gives the sign. Each category (by id in category_ids) may feed only one line per year (409 names the line that has it). Unknown category → 400.

409.description: category already used by another line, or duplicate line name

put.description: Requires the manage-budget role. Full overwrite of the line, including its categories. Same validation as creating one.

delete.description: Requires the manage-budget role. Its categories become unbudgeted for that year.

get.description: Requires the list-transactions or manage-rules role. Mandatory categories first. parent_id is null for top-level categories.

post.description: Requires the manage-transactions role. Always created with is_mandatory=false. Optional parent_id must be an existing top-level category.

delete.description: Requires the manage-transactions role. Mandatory categories and categories still in use cannot be deleted.

409.description: category still has sub-categories or is referenced by transactions, rules or budget lines

get.description: Requires the view-rules or manage-rules role. Evaluation order; disabled rules included.

post.description: Requires the manage-rules role. Always kind=pattern. Every set condition must match (AND); at least one besides direction is required. Blank strings count as unset.

put.description: Requires the manage-rules role. Full overwrite: omitted optional fields are cleared. Built-in rules (own_account, member_variable_symbol): only priority, enabled and note may change.

delete.description: Requires the manage-rules role. Built-in rules cannot be deleted, only disabled. Already-categorized transactions keep their category.

post.description: Requires the manage-rules role. Applies only this rule to already-processed transactions it matches, dated on or after from (inclusive; optional, defaults to 1 January of the current year, which is also the minimum unless the caller holds override-rules); no other rule is evaluated. Manual edits and transactions decided by an earlier rule are kept. succeeded = transactions changed. 400 for a disabled rule or an invalid from.
post.summary: Apply one categorization rule to history

get.description: Requires the view-event-logs role. Merges Fio and Orca sync runs into one feed, newest first.
Requires only a valid token — no role. Resolves the member from the token's sub. Same shape as GET /payments/{member_number}/history.
get.summary: Get the caller's own payment history

403.description: token has no valid sub, or no member found for it

get.description: Requires the payment-history role. window_from/window_to are the trailing rolling month (today minus 1 calendar month through today, both inclusive) — no year/month params, always a live "as of now" snapshot. Counts a real transaction.transaction_date landing in that window, not the arrears/coverage-month convention the other payment endpoints use.
get.summary: Org-wide % of members paying dues in the trailing month

get.description: Requires the manage-transactions role. All members, newest-created first.
Requires the view-workplace-payment-history role. Scoped live to the caller's own Keycloak workplace group(s) via the Account API.
get.summary: Workplace-scoped: commented transactions in a year

get.description: Requires the view-workplace-payment-history role. Scoped live to the caller's own Keycloak workplace group(s) via the Account API.
get.summary: Workplace-scoped: members who missed a payment in a year

get.description: Requires the view-workplace-payment-history role. Scoped live to the caller's own Keycloak workplace group(s) via the Account API.
get.summary: Workplace-scoped: commented transactions in one month

get.description: Requires the view-workplace-payment-history role. Scoped live to the caller's own Keycloak workplace group(s) via the Account API.
get.summary: Workplace-scoped: members missing a payment for one month

get.description: Requires payment-history (any member) or view-workplace-payment-history (own workplace's members only). Includes waived months (amount "Waived", no real transaction fields) alongside real payments.

post.description: Requires the manage-transactions role. Idempotent per month (repeat calls keep the original reason). Without end_year/end_month, 400 if the month is already covered by a real payment; with them, such months are skipped instead (see the `skipped` field).
post.summary: Write off a member's missed month (or range of months)

parameters.description: Month (or start/end range) to waive, and why
parameters.name: request

delete.description: Requires the manage-transactions role. The month reappears in missing-payment lists on the next read.

get.description: Requires the payment-history role. Every admin_comment'd transaction dated in this year, independent of missed-payment status.
Requires the payment-history role. total_missed_months/has_ever_paid are full-liability-window figures, not scoped to the queried year.
get.summary: Members who missed at least one payment in a year

get.description: Requires the payment-history role. Every admin_comment'd transaction dated in this month, independent of missed-payment status.
Requires the payment-history role. A waived month is excluded from this list, same as a paid one.
get.summary: Members missing a payment for one month

post.description: Requires manage-bank-accounts or manage-transactions (which, depends on the action). Body selects the action: "run" (categorize unprocessed transactions, needs manage-bank-accounts).

get.description: Requires the list-transactions role. All filters optional and combinable. bank_account_color is the transaction's bank account color (#RRGGBB), null if unset.

parameters.description: true = has a member match, false = the unassigned worklist
parameters.name: assigned

parameters.description: With category_id: also match that category's sub-categories. Default false
parameters.name: include_children

parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring match against counterparty name/number or message/comment
parameters.name: search

get.description: Requires the view-budget role. Grouped by direction/category/currency only — no member_number or counterparty, safe for wide member-facing use. current_balance is a live total across every bank account (grouped by currency), not scoped by from/to.

parameters.description: true = report sub-categories under their parent category. Default false
parameters.name: rollup

get.description: Requires the list-transactions role.

put.description: Requires the manage-transactions role. member_number optional (category-only edit if omitted); covers optional (defaults to the month before the transaction's own); admin_comment optional staff note, omit or empty string to clear.

delete.description: Requires the manage-transactions role. Clears member/matched_by and category_set_manually, deletes coverage rows, resets category to the direction default. Rules are not re-run.

admin_comment.description: optional staff note; omit or empty string to clear, full overwrite like member_number

covers.description: optional; empty = the transaction's own month

member_number.description: optional; omit for a category-only edit, no member match

balance.description:
Balance/BalanceAsOf are both nil until the account's first successful
sync — see bank_accounts.balance in "Database schema" (CLAUDE.md).

color.description: Color is nil when unset — optional, purely presentational.

budgeted.description: always positive; kind gives the sign

actual.description:
Actual is the year's actual CZK amount for the line's categories,
signed so it reads positive in the normal case (spend for an expense
line, receipts for an income line); a refund lowers it.

budgeted.description: always positive; kind gives the sign

as_of.description: YYYY-MM-DD the actual figures were computed on

other_currency_count.description:
OtherCurrencyCount is how many of the year's transactions weren't in
CZK and so aren't in any figure here.

unbudgeted.description:
Unbudgeted lists the year's transactions in categories no line maps
(internal transfers excluded), so incomes − expenses reconcile.

current_balance.description:
CurrentBalance is a live snapshot (sum of every bank_accounts.balance,
grouped by currency, as of each account's own last successful sync —
see UpdateBankAccountBalance), not scoped by from/to like
Incoming/Outgoing are — there's no "balance as of a date range", only
"balance right now".

copy_from_year.description:
CopyFromYear, if set, copies that year's lines — names, groups, order,
budgeted amounts and category mappings — into the new budget, so a
new year starts from last year's sheet.

has_ever_paid.description:
HasEverPaid is false when the member has no payment_coverage row at
all — never made a single matched payment, as opposed to usually
paying and missing one month. In practice a common, distinct case
(e.g. a member who never received/actioned their bank details) that
needs different follow-up than an occasional miss, so callers can
filter on it instead of inferring it from total_missed_months alone.

total_missed_months.description:
TotalMissedMonths is the member's unpaid months across their whole
liability window, not just the queried month — a contact-priority signal.
Always >= 1 for a member in this list; rows come pre-sorted by it,
descending (top offenders first).

from.description:
From is the first transaction date (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive) the rule is
applied to. Optional, defaults to 1 January of the current year, which
is also the earliest allowed — closed years are never rewritten —
unless the caller holds override-rules.

color.description:
Color is optional and purely presentational (a #RRGGBB hex string shown
as a swatch next to the account and on its transactions) — no business
logic reads it. Unlike FioToken this is a full overwrite every call: nil
or "" clears it, any other value replaces it. The frontend always sends
the field's current value rather than treating omission as "unchanged".

end_year.description:
EndYear/EndMonth are optional — together they turn a single-month waive
into a range [Year/Month .. EndYear/EndMonth] inclusive. Both or
neither: providing one without the other is a 400.

BearerAuth.description: Keycloak-issued bearer token for bank-system's Keycloak client, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Which role(s) a given route requires is noted on that route below — see internal/keycloak.Role for the full list.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
